entities.name: Bryce
entities.description: A city-state in Jamuraa on Dominaria near the mouth of the River Toloron and the Bay of Pearls.

entities.name: Jamuraa
entities.description: The continent on which Bryce lay.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which Bryce was located.

entities.name: Hazezon Tamar
entities.description: Governor of Bryce, with sand warriors.

entities.name: Tirras
entities.description: A neighboring city that often attacked Bryce.

entities.name: Battle of Bryce
entities.description: The first battle in Johan's War, in which Tirrans swarmed Bryce.

entities.name: Johan's War
entities.description: A war whose first battle was the Battle of Bryce.

entities.name: Xira Arien
entities.description: A young wizard who defeated Hazezon Tamar's sand warriors using Stone-Throwing Devils.

entities.name: Jaeger Ojanen
entities.description: A cat warrior befriended by Bryce who fought ferociously in its defense.

entities.name: Keepers of the Faith
entities.description: Those who tended the Temple of Anthius.

events.summary: In the Battle of Bryce, the first battle of Johan's War, Tirrans swarm the streets of Bryce.
events.quote: the Battle of Bryce was the first battle in Johan's War

events.summary: Xira Arien defeats Hazezon Tamar's sand warriors using Stone-Throwing Devils.
events.quote: able to defeat Hazezon Tamar 's sand warriors through the use of Stone-Throwing Devils

events.summary: Jaeger Ojanen fights ferociously, allowing Bryce's defenders to chase the Tirrans out.
events.quote: allowing the city's defenders to chase the Tirrans out

relations.quote: Bryce was a city-state in Jamuraa on the plane of Dominaria .
Bryce was often attacked by neighboring Tirras

relations.note: befriended the city and fought for it
relations.quote: Bryce had recently befriended the cat warrior Jaeger Ojanen
